description: This file defines an interface for a factory that creates clients for Hono's Device Connection API. It includes a static method to instantiate the factory given a connection and a method to obtain a device connection client for a specified tenant.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactory
classes.description: An interface for a factory that creates device connection clients for Hono's Device Connection API.

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static method to instantiate the factory using an existing HonoConnection.

methods.name: getOrCreateDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Returns a Future that will complete with a device connection client for the specified tenant, or fail if creation is not possible.
